usage_scope: observed responses only; failed calls may still be billed

rubric.instructions: How sufficient is the supplied evidence for the stated, single-test claim? Judge only supplied evidence, do not infer missing provenance or claim broader conformance. This is advisory evidence quality, never a pass/fail verdict.
levels: No supplied evidence supports the bounded claim, or the supplied evidence contradicts it.
Only an unsupported assertion or aggregate summary supports the bounded claim.
A matching test result row supports the bounded claim, but suite or implementation identity is missing.
A matching test result row and pinned suite and implementation identities support the bounded claim, but producer or reproduction evidence is incomplete.
A matching result row, pinned suite and implementation identities, named producer and reproduction procedure support the bounded claim. This does not independently verify execution.
